## Implemented
- **Job ads near real time by polling: Airflow DAG every ten minutes** · Jobs
  infra/airflow/ runs platform/job_assistant/realtime.py (collect, analyse, build, publish) with overlap handling, source-time ordering, stage state in pipeline.json and a lock. Twelve consecutive ten-minute releases on a runner, median delay 6.8 to 11.7 min. docs/job-ads-airflow.md.
